senses.gloss:
ITA-5.70.8 mṛtagarbhaḥ मृतगर्भः
Intrauterine fetal death
Death of fetus in the uterus characterized by feeling as if the abdomen is wrapped in a wet cloth; stiff abdomen; stretched abdomen; abdomen cold to touch; stony hard fetus; absence of fetal movements; severe pain; no labour pain; no discharge from yoni; sluggish eyes; distressed mother; giddiness or dizziness; difficulty in breathing; distress/discontent/ restlessness; improper manifestation of natural urges; cessation of labour pain; blackishness or cyanosis; pallor; foetid smell on breath; colicky pain in abdomen; inflated abdomen; thirst; difficulty in breathing; exhaustion without exertion; mother crying constantly; sleeplessness; difficulty in breathing.

ITA-9.7.44 mṛtasañjīvanam (viṣopakrama) मृतसञ्जीवनम् (विषोपक्रम)
Life-reviving
Therapy or medicines able to revive a patient.
